text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The highest grade of flood alert has been introduced along the Danube at Szigetkoz, northwest Hungary, as a new flood wave, similar to the one which passed last week, is coming down the river.
- Hungary will send a new aid shipment on Wednesday to the Polish region hit by floods.
- The agenda of the meeting of the Hungarian and Slovak foreign ministers today include the question of NATO enlargement as Hungary is likely to receive early membership but Slovakia not.
- Ethnic Hungarians in Romania have protested over that some of the freshly set bilingual traffic tables had been painted down by Romanians.
- Irregularities treatment of a mine shell left behind from the Second World War led to the death of two soldiers on Sunday in Dunaharaszti.
